## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `retrieval-contradiction-gating`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-08T22:51:13.305Z.

Planning pass 2026-07-08 (third follow-up): Algorithm (14) retrieval-conditioned contradiction gating for memory reconsolidation (serves pm-vvib candidate 15). Purpose: decide WHEN a retrieved precedent becomes eligible for an append-only correction delta, so the corpus self-corrects under use without thrashing on every read. Mechanism, three stages. Stage 1 — retrieval events as cheap immutable facts: whenever context assembly (algorithm 7 funnel) serves a precedent item into an agent's envelope, fold a (retriever, precedent_id, ts) retrieval event into sketch state (algorithm 8) — O(1), no daemon, replayable from the streams. Stage 2 — contradiction scoring at the NEXT write: when the retrieving agent later records an outcome on its own item (close with resolution/expected/actual, a learning, a decision), compute an explainable linear contradiction score (algorithm 3 weights) between that outcome and each recently-retrieved precedent: (a) outcome divergence — precedent's recorded resolution vs the new expected-vs-actual pair (categorical mismatch = strong signal); (b) estimate divergence — |log(actual_minutes/estimated_minutes)| of the new work when the precedent supplied the estimate prior; (c) semantic opposition — embedding distance flip between precedent decision text and the new learning text (reuses the existing vector index, no new store); (d) structural relevance gate — WL fingerprint similarity (algorithm 10) between the two work contexts, so only contradictions in STRUCTURALLY SIMILAR situations count (a divergent outcome in an unrelated context is noise, not correction pressure). Eligibility opens only when score crosses a threshold AND the habituation guard passes: per (retriever, precedent) pair at most one open window per K retrievals, mirroring the biological constraint that reconsolidation needs a labile window, not constant rewriting. Stage 3 — correction pressure as a fold-time retrieval signal: accepted deltas append as ordinary immutable events pairing (precedent_id, retrieving_context_id, correction); write-time maintenance (algorithm 6) folds a decaying correction-pressure counter per precedent that (i) demotes the precedent's retrieval rank proportionally, floored so originals never disappear (immutability + auditability), and (ii) attaches the N most recent corrections whenever the precedent IS served (candidate 15 acceptance shape). Confirmations (retrievals followed by consistent outcomes) fold the opposite way and harden rank — spaced retrieval-practice strengthening (pm-uwfs territory) composes here rather than duplicating. Spectrum behavior: small workspaces rarely cross threshold, cost is one sketch fold per retrieval; million-item workspaces get a queryable relitigation surface — precedents with sustained correction pressure are exactly the decisions the organisation keeps re-arguing, surfaced via ordinary list/search over folded metadata rather than a batch job.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
